summary: Turn emerging privacy obligations into AI, cloud and cross-border controls. Explore the advanced course and strengthen your compliance roadmap.
lede: Multi-jurisdiction data privacy training helps privacy officers, counsel and technology leaders turn obligations into workable controls for AI and cloud services. Participants practise mapping data flows, tracing obligations to controls and evidence, assessing transfer risks, and reviewing AI and product designs, then use their findings to prioritize a compliance roadmap without coding.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or support privacy decisions across legal regimes, product teams and technology services. It suits experienced practitioners who need to translate obligations into controls, design decisions and evidence.
prerequisites: Advanced level. You should have working knowledge of privacy governance, personal-data processing and at least one organization-wide privacy or security process. No coding or programming is required; the course treats AI and cloud engineering through architecture, risk and governance exercises.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
